text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A plan to improve trading on the stock exchange and ease procedures for investment in securities. Economy Minister Youssef Boutros-Ghali and the head of the bourse say they will put in place a new system to provide information for the traders and ease access and exit from the market.
- The national soccer squad thrashes Ethiopia 8-1.
- Court case in which six people are on trial for libelling Gamal and Alaa Mubarak has been postponed until September 7.
- President Hosni Mubarak has issued directives to solve problems caused by traffic congestion in two main roads in Giza governorate.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri tells al-Akhbar: The administrative structure will be overhauled. We will take strong action against those who break the traffic and environment laws.
- Mubarak says in a television interview: There is no military cooperation between Egypt and Iran.
- Earthquake measuring 5.2 Richter hits Egypt, no damages.
- Economic group of ministers discussed 16 articles in the new investment incentives law.
